title: Feature-edge agreement filter (saddle OR 2-of-3 sources)
description:
Context: in the STAGES diagnostic view of the skull (see PatchRenderer.renderFeatureEdgeMultiview mode=STAGES on voyage_skull_ref.obj), the user identified purple (saddle) and white (multi-source, ≥2 of {dihedral, principal, crest} agree) as the signals that land on real anatomical boundaries. Red (crest-only) and light-blue (dihedral-only) are spurious noise that today pollutes `allFeatureEdges` and causes region-growing to fragment patches in the wrong places (teeth cut horizontally instead of between teeth, socket rims broken by noise). The current p95 principal threshold already reduced the principal-only flood; this ticket takes the next step by refusing to promote single-source edges at all.

Proposed change in SemanticPatchDecomposer.decomposeWithDiagnostics near line 236 (where `allFeatureEdges` is built):

Replace:
```
allFeatureEdges.addAll(principalFeatureEdges);
allFeatureEdges.addAll(crest.crestEdges);
allFeatureEdges.addAll(saddle.separatorEdges);
...
allFeatureEdges.addAll(dihedralFeatureEdges);
```

With an agreement test: an edge is promoted iff
 (a) it is in saddle.separatorEdges (topology-directed, always trusted), OR
 (b) it is in ≥2 of {dihedralFeatureEdges, principalFeatureEdges, crest.crestEdges}.

All four underlying sets remain in DecompositionDiagnostics so the STAGES overlay still shows the raw per-source signal. Only the promoted set that feeds `featureCutAdjacency` and `adjCrestOnly` changes.

Critical files:
- ixdar-app/src/main/java/ixdar/geometry/mesh/data/SemanticPatchDecomposer.java — decomposeWithDiagnostics, lines 184-256.
- ixdar-app/src/main/java/ixdar/geometry/mesh/data/CrestLineDetector.java — unchanged (source of crest.crestEdges).
- ixdar-app/src/main/java/ixdar/geometry/mesh/data/SaddlePointDetector.java — unchanged (source of saddle.separatorEdges).

Verify with PatchRenderer.renderFeatureEdgeMultiview mode=CREST_VS_BOUNDARY on voyage_skull_ref.obj at zoom=2.5 — ratio of green (honored) to red (ignored) edges should improve meaningfully, teeth region should stop showing horizontal cuts through tooth bodies, socket rims should fragment less.
definition-of-done:
1. An edge is added to `allFeatureEdges` only if it is a saddle separator OR appears in at least 2 of {dihedral, principal, crest} sources.
2. `DecompositionDiagnostics` still exposes each source independently for the STAGES overlay — no change to the record shape beyond what already exists.
3. On voyage_skull_ref.obj at resolution=128, the skull's orbital rim, zygomatic, and cranium regions stay as clean as they are today (no regression in already-working areas).
4. Teeth region no longer shows horizontal cuts through tooth bodies in PatchRenderer.renderMultiviewFlat at zoom=2.5; per-tooth separation may still be imperfect but the wrong-direction cuts disappear.
5. Patch count on skull should drop meaningfully (currently 210) since noise edges were forcing over-fragmentation.
testing-plan:
1. Run the headless diagnostic /tmp/VerifyFeatureEdges.java on voyage_skull_ref.obj — confirm dihedral, principal, crest, saddle edge counts unchanged (sources aren't being modified), but union_edges drops.
2. Render PatchRenderer.renderFeatureEdgeMultiview mode=CREST_VS_BOUNDARY at zoom=2.5 — compare green/red/black distribution to the pre-change baseline. Green should increase, red should decrease.
3. Render PatchRenderer.renderMultiviewFlat at zoom=2.5 and read the Right + 3/4 Front-R views — confirm teeth region no longer has horizontal strips across tooth bodies, and cranium/zygomatic/orbital regions are unchanged.
4. Launch desktop mesh viewer, load skull, press P then Shift+P to cycle into STAGES — saddle (purple) and multi-source (white) edges should still show as they do today; they're not being filtered out of the overlay, only out of the cut-set.
